title.en: Meeting reminder with fake details page
title.es: Recordatorio de reunión con página de detalles falsa

lure: A TeamHub meeting reminder for a '2027 Project Discussion' with a plausible colleague name. The email links to a convincing fake meeting details page; the trap is the reschedule link on that page, not the initial button.
review_notes: Spanish text written by Claude; have a native speaker review before use with learners.
This kit includes an extra page (meeting.html) between the email and the coaching page. The checker does not scan meeting.html — safety rules were applied manually.
The two-step design is intentional: the first click (Review Meeting Details) feels safe. The trap is the Reschedule link on the meeting details page.
